-- =============================================================================
-- CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL: CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE (Calculation View CUBE/Aggregation)
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_week_ending_from  STRING  -- Fiscal week start (zzweek lower bound, STRING per BQ_DATATYPE)
--   @ip_week_ending_to    STRING  -- Fiscal week end   (zzweek upper bound, STRING per BQ_DATATYPE)
--   @ip_version_comp_flag STRING  -- Comp flag version (comp_ver, STRING per BQ_DATATYPE)
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: JOURNAL_ENT_ACDOCA
-- Logic: Projects journal entry line items from the ACDOCA physical table,
--        applying the client filter (rclnt IN ('120','200')) from
--        CV_BASE_FIN_ACDOCA_S4 and the fiscal-week range filter from
--        CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE. Only columns required by downstream
--        joins and calculations are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_acdoca
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200'); zzweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
JOURNAL_ENT_ACDOCA AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    prctr,
    zzweek,
    ksl,
    blart,
    rbukrs,
    gjahr,
    belnr,
    wwpc_pa,
    racct
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_acdoca`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
    AND zzweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: BKPF_Filtered
-- Logic: Projects accounting document headers from the BKPF physical
--        table, applying the client filter (mandt IN ('120','200')) from
--        CV_BASE_FIN_BKPF_S4 and the document-type inclusion filter
--        from CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE (xref2_hd IN allowed list).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bkpf
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); xref2_hd IN ('MJE','TS','GENCO','MAR','SAPARINVOICES','TP')
-- =====================================================================
BKPF_Filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    bukrs,
    belnr,
    gjahr,
    xref2_hd
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bkpf`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND xref2_hd IN ('MJE', 'TS', 'GENCO', 'MAR', 'SAPARINVOICES', 'TP')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Joined_Journal_BKPF
-- Logic: Inner-joins journal entry lines to filtered BKPF headers on
--        company code, document number, and fiscal year. The join
--        eliminates journal lines without a matching MJE-type header.
--        xref2_hd is carried forward for the subsequent exclusion filter.
-- Source: JOURNAL_ENT_ACDOCA, BKPF_Filtered
-- Join: INNER JOIN BKPF_Filtered ON rbukrs = bukrs AND belnr = belnr AND gjahr = gjahr
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Journal_BKPF AS (
  SELECT
    j.rclnt,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.ksl,
    b.mandt,
    b.xref2_hd,
    j.wwpc_pa,
    j.racct
  FROM JOURNAL_ENT_ACDOCA j
  INNER JOIN BKPF_Filtered b
    ON j.rbukrs = b.bukrs
    AND j.belnr  = b.belnr
    AND j.gjahr  = b.gjahr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: Filtered_Journal_BKPF
-- Logic: Applies the secondary exclusion filter from CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE
--        (Projection_1 node): removes rows where xref2_hd is in the
--        reversal/skip set ('RT','RV','SK'). xref2_hd is aliased as
--        source_code per the final-consumer output contract.
-- Source: Joined_Journal_BKPF
-- Filters: xref2_hd NOT IN ('RT','RV','SK')
-- =====================================================================
Filtered_Journal_BKPF AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    ksl,
    zzweek,
    prctr,
    rclnt,
    xref2_hd AS source_code,
    wwpc_pa,
    racct
  FROM Joined_Journal_BKPF
  WHERE xref2_hd NOT IN ('RT', 'RV', 'SK')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: PC_HIER_Filtered
-- Logic: Projects profit-center hierarchy nodes from the HRRP_NODE
--        physical table for the PC_HEIR variant. Applies the client
--        filter (mandt IN ('120','200')) from CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4
--        and the CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE filters: parnode LIKE '%CORE_RET%'
--        and hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31' (HANA DATS '99991231' converted
--        to BigQuery DATE literal; hryvalto BQ_DATATYPE = DATE).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); parnode LIKE '%CORE_RET%'; hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
-- =====================================================================
PC_HIER_Filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    parnode,
    nodevalue,
    hryvalto
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode LIKE '%CORE_RET%'
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: Joined_Journal_PC_HIER
-- Logic: Inner-joins filtered journal entries to the PC hierarchy to
--        retain only journal lines whose profit center (prctr) is a
--        node value in the CORE_RET profit-center hierarchy. This
--        implements the PC_HIER join in CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE.
-- Source: Filtered_Journal_BKPF, PC_HIER_Filtered
-- Join: INNER JOIN PC_HIER_Filtered ON prctr = nodevalue AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Journal_PC_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    f.ksl,
    f.zzweek,
    f.prctr,
    f.rclnt,
    f.wwpc_pa,
    f.racct,
    f.mandt,
    f.source_code
  FROM Filtered_Journal_BKPF f
  INNER JOIN PC_HIER_Filtered p
    ON f.prctr  = p.nodevalue
    AND f.mandt = p.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: GL_HIER_Filtered
-- Logic: Projects GL account hierarchy nodes from the HRRP_NODE physical
--        table for the GL_HEIR variant. Applies the client filter
--        (mandt IN ('120','200')) from CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4 and the
--        CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE filters: parnode LIKE '%181',
--        hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31', hryid = 'CVS2'.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); parnode LIKE '%181'; hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'; hryid = 'CVS2'
-- =====================================================================
GL_HIER_Filtered AS (
  SELECT
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    mandt,
    nodevalue,
    hryid
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode LIKE '%181'
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
    AND hryid = 'CVS2'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: Joined_GL_HIER
-- Logic: Inner-joins the PC-hierarchy-filtered journal entries to the GL
--        account hierarchy to retain only lines whose GL account (racct)
--        is a node value in the CVS2 GL hierarchy ending in '181'.
-- Source: Joined_Journal_PC_HIER, GL_HIER_Filtered
-- Join: INNER JOIN GL_HIER_Filtered ON racct = nodevalue AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_GL_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    j.mandt,
    j.rclnt,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.ksl,
    j.wwpc_pa,
    j.racct,
    j.source_code
  FROM Joined_Journal_PC_HIER j
  INNER JOIN GL_HIER_Filtered g
    ON j.racct  = g.nodevalue
    AND j.mandt = g.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: PROD_CLASS_HIER_Filtered
-- Logic: Projects product-class hierarchy nodes from the HRRP_NODE
--        physical table for the PROD_CLASS_HEIR variant. Applies the
--        client filter (mandt IN ('120','200')) from CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4
--        and the CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE filters: (parnode LIKE '%FS' OR
--        parnode LIKE '%RX'), hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31', and
--        hryid LIKE '%ZPRODUCTCLASS'.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'); (parnode LIKE '%FS' OR parnode LIKE '%RX');
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'; hryid LIKE '%ZPRODUCTCLASS'
-- =====================================================================
PROD_CLASS_HIER_Filtered AS (
  SELECT
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    hryid,
    nodevalue,
    mandt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND (parnode LIKE '%FS' OR parnode LIKE '%RX')
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
    AND hryid LIKE '%ZPRODUCTCLASS'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: Joined_Prod_Class_Hier
-- Logic: Inner-joins the GL-hierarchy-filtered journal entries to the
--        product-class hierarchy to retain only lines whose product-class
--        PA field (wwpc_pa) is a node value in the ZPRODUCTCLASS hierarchy
--        with FS or RX parent nodes. parnode is carried forward as it
--        drives the final COMP_FLAG and restricted-measure calculations.
-- Source: Joined_GL_HIER, PROD_CLASS_HIER_Filtered
-- Join: INNER JOIN PROD_CLASS_HIER_Filtered ON wwpc_pa = nodevalue AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Prod_Class_Hier AS (
  SELECT
    g.mandt,
    g.rclnt,
    g.prctr,
    g.zzweek,
    g.ksl,
    g.racct,
    g.wwpc_pa,
    p.parnode,
    g.source_code
  FROM Joined_GL_HIER g
  INNER JOIN PROD_CLASS_HIER_Filtered p
    ON g.wwpc_pa = p.nodevalue
    AND g.mandt  = p.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: STORE_ATTR_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Logic: Projects store profile attributes from the ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT
--        physical table, applying the client filter
--        (mandt IN ('120','200')) from CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4. Only the
--        columns required by the downstream join and final output are
--        projected. The CUBE/Aggregation semantics of CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4
--        are absorbed here; the columns used downstream are all dimension
--        attributes, so no aggregation boundary is required at this stage.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_JOURNAL_ENT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    city,
    state,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: Joined_Store_Attr
-- Logic: Left-joins the product-class-filtered journal entries to store
--        attributes on profit center and client. A left join preserves
--        journal entries that have no matching store attribute record.
-- Source: Joined_Prod_Class_Hier, STORE_ATTR_JOURNAL_ENT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_JOURNAL_ENT ON prctr = prctr AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Store_Attr AS (
  SELECT
    j.mandt,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.division_code,
    s.area_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.area_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.district_code,
    s.district_desc,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    j.rclnt,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.ksl,
    j.parnode,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    j.wwpc_pa,
    s.strnum,
    j.source_code,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Prod_Class_Hier j
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_JOURNAL_ENT s
    ON j.prctr  = s.prctr
    AND j.mandt = s.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: COMP_FLAG_JOURNAL_ENT_Filtered
-- Logic: Projects comp-flag records from the ZTSRP_COMPFL physical table,
--        applying the client filter (mandt IN ('110','200')) from
--        CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4 (note: this view uses 110 and 200, not 120
--        and 200) and the CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE parameter filter
--        comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'); comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_JOURNAL_ENT_Filtered AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE mandt IN ('110', '200')
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: Joined_Comp_Flag
-- Logic: Left-joins the store-attribute-enriched journal entries to
--        comp-flag records on profit center, fiscal week (zzweek = zweek),
--        and client. A left join preserves journal entries without a
--        matching comp-flag record. rx_comp_wk and fs_comp_wk are carried
--        forward for the COMP_FLAG calculation in the final SELECT.
-- Source: Joined_Store_Attr, COMP_FLAG_JOURNAL_ENT_Filtered
-- Join: LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_JOURNAL_ENT_Filtered ON prctr = prctr AND zzweek = zweek AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Comp_Flag AS (
  SELECT
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    s.emerg_mkt_ind,
    s.district_code,
    s.region_desc,
    s.region_code,
    s.rclnt,
    s.prctr,
    s.zzweek,
    s.ksl,
    s.rep_mkt_code,
    s.rep_mkt_desc,
    s.division_code,
    s.area_code,
    s.division_desc,
    s.area_desc,
    s.district_desc,
    s.fs_open_dat,
    s.rx_open_dat,
    s.parnode,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    s.wwpc_pa,
    s.strnum,
    s.mandt,
    s.source_code,
    s.rx_division_code,
    s.rx_area_code,
    s.rx_region_code,
    s.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Store_Attr s
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_JOURNAL_ENT_Filtered j
    ON s.prctr  = j.prctr
    AND s.zzweek = j.zweek
    AND s.mandt  = j.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Projects profit-center long text (ltext aliased as
--        profit_center_text) from the CEPCT physical table, applying
--        the client filter (mandt IN ('120','200')) from
--        CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4. Only mandt, prctr, and ltext are needed.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 16: Joined_Profit_Center_Text
-- Logic: Left-joins the comp-flag-enriched result to profit-center text
--        on profit center and client. A left join preserves rows without
--        a matching text record.
-- Source: Joined_Comp_Flag, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT ON prctr = prctr AND mandt = mandt
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Profit_Center_Text AS (
  SELECT
    c.mandt,
    c.rx_comp_wk,
    c.fs_comp_wk,
    c.emerg_mkt_ind,
    c.district_code,
    c.region_desc,
    c.region_code,
    c.rclnt,
    c.prctr,
    c.zzweek,
    c.district_desc,
    c.area_desc,
    c.division_desc,
    c.area_code,
    c.division_code,
    c.rep_mkt_desc,
    c.rep_mkt_code,
    c.ksl,
    p.profit_center_text,
    c.fs_open_dat,
    c.rx_open_dat,
    c.parnode,
    c.city,
    c.state,
    c.wwpc_pa,
    c.strnum,
    c.source_code,
    c.rx_division_code,
    c.rx_area_code,
    c.rx_region_code,
    c.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Comp_Flag c
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT p
    ON c.prctr  = p.prctr
    AND c.mandt = p.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 17: CAL_WEEK
-- Logic: Projects retail calendar week records from the ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK
--        physical table, applying the client filter
--        (rclnt IN ('120','200')) from CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4. Only
--        the columns needed for the calendar-week join are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
CAL_WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    zzweek,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 18: Joined_Calendar_Week
-- Logic: Left-joins the profit-center-text-enriched result to the retail
--        calendar week on zzweek and client (mandt = rclnt). Computes
--        the three calculated columns defined in CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE:
--          cal_week_number = RIGHT(zzweek, 2)  [last 2 chars of STRING zzweek]
--          cal_fs_rx_flag  = CASE LEFT(wwpc_pa,2) WHEN 'FS' THEN 'FS'
--                                                 WHEN 'RX' THEN 'RX'
--                                                 ELSE ''   END
--          ksl (raw row-level value, renamed ksl_negative per output
--               contract; the negated aggregate is computed in the final
--               SELECT to preserve the aggregation grain boundary)
--        zrwstrtdate and zrwenddate are DATE type per BQ_DATATYPE.
-- Source: Joined_Profit_Center_Text, CAL_WEEK
-- Join: LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK ON zzweek = zzweek AND mandt = rclnt
-- Calculation: cal_week_number = RIGHT(zzweek,2); cal_fs_rx_flag via CASE on LEFT(wwpc_pa,2)
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Calendar_Week AS (
  SELECT
    j.mandt,
    j.rx_comp_wk,
    j.fs_comp_wk,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.district_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.rclnt,
    j.prctr,
    j.zzweek,
    j.district_desc,
    j.area_desc,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.division_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.profit_center_text,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.parnode,
    j.ksl,
    c.zrwstrtdate,
    c.zrwenddate,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.wwpc_pa,
    j.strnum,
    j.source_code,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    RIGHT(j.zzweek, 2) AS cal_week_number,
    CASE LEFT(j.wwpc_pa, 2)
      WHEN 'FS' THEN 'FS'
      WHEN 'RX' THEN 'RX'
      ELSE ''
    END AS cal_fs_rx_flag
  FROM Joined_Profit_Center_Text j
  LEFT JOIN CAL_WEEK c
    ON j.zzweek = c.zzweek
    AND j.mandt = c.rclnt
)

-- =====================================================================
-- Final SELECT (Aggregation)
-- Logic: Aggregates all rows from Joined_Calendar_Week over the full
--        dimension grain defined by CV_COMP_FIN_MANUAL_JE (CUBE /
--        outputViewType="Aggregation"). Measures:
--          ksl_negative = SUM(ksl)          [sum of raw KSL values]
--          ksl          = SUM(ksl) * -1     [negated aggregate per CV logic:
--                                            KSL = KSL_NEGATIVE * -1]
--        COMP_FLAG is computed post-aggregation using MAX of the
--        appropriate comp-week column selected by cal_fs_rx_flag, as
--        required for correct measure calculation in BigQuery (CASE on
--        an aggregation result). fs_rx_flag output alias maps
--        cal_fs_rx_flag per the output contract.
-- Source: Joined_Calendar_Week
-- Aggregation: SUM(ksl) AS ksl_negative; SUM(ksl)*-1 AS ksl; MAX-based COMP_FLAG
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  rx_comp_wk,
  fs_comp_wk,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rclnt,
  prctr,
  zzweek,
  district_desc,
  area_desc,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  division_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  parnode,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  city,
  state,
  cal_week_number,
  CASE cal_fs_rx_flag
    WHEN 'FS' THEN MAX(fs_comp_wk)
    WHEN 'RX' THEN MAX(rx_comp_wk)
    ELSE            MAX(fs_comp_wk)
  END AS comp_flag,
  cal_fs_rx_flag AS fs_rx_flag,
  SUM(ksl)      AS ksl_negative,
  SUM(ksl) * -1 AS ksl,
  strnum,
  source_code,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
FROM Joined_Calendar_Week
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  rx_comp_wk,
  fs_comp_wk,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  district_code,
  region_desc,
  region_code,
  rclnt,
  prctr,
  zzweek,
  district_desc,
  area_desc,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  division_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  rep_mkt_code,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  parnode,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  city,
  state,
  cal_week_number,
  cal_fs_rx_flag,
  strnum,
  source_code,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
